title: How to read cleanroom class standards (ISO 14644-1 and US Federal Standard), plus FFUs and ULPA filters [Cleaning Level 3, Lesson 1 Extra]
excerpt: An explanation of how to read cleanroom classes and the paths contamination takes to get in. In this extra lesson for Cleaning Level 3, learn how clean semiconductor fabs are, why air flows from top to bottom, and why people are the biggest source of contamination. You can also review key terms and common misconceptions.
